name: abap-file-formats
description: File formats that define and specify the file representation for ABAP development objects

scripts.copy: cp -r tools/src downport && cp tools/deps/* downport && rm downport/*.prog.* && rm downport/zcl_aff_writer_xslt.clas.testclasses.abap && cp ../file-formats/*.abap downport && cp ../file-formats/*/type/*.abap downport && cp cl_run.clas.abap downport
scripts.compile: rm -rf downport && npm run clone && npm run copy && npm run transpile
scripts.test: npm run compile && npm run generate

author: SAP
